text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident triggered — metering-ingest-threshold - P1
pagerduty: Page fired to schedule: metering-oncall (pagerduty incident #PD-87234)
sarah: ack
sarah: Looking into consumer lag on metering-ingest topic. Seeing backlog ~1.2M messages.
raj: on it, what's the impact? invoices?
luis: finance reports some invoices are queued. token counts may be under-reporting for the last ~6h.
sarah: root consumer group 'metering-ingest-consumers' is lagging. Brokers appear healthy. Suspect consumer crashloop after recent http-client patch.
mike: 👍 suggest scaling the consumers and bumping max.poll.records, also check offset commit errors in logs.
sarah: running quick pod check: 
```
$ kubectl get pods -n metering
NAME                                        READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
metering-ingest-consumer-0                  1/1     Running            12         3d
metering-ingest-consumer-1                  0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   27         2h
```
raj: grabbing logs from consumer-1 now.
raj: logs show repeated OffsetCommitFailedException followed by HTTP 502 on external auth service.
```
2026-03-14T09:02:13Z ERROR OffsetCommitFailedException: commit failed for partition metering-3, offsets:...
Caused by: java.net.SocketTimeoutException: Read timed out
```
sarah: restarting consumer-1 to get it back into the group.
pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by sarah (pagerduty ack at 09:05 UTC)
sarah: restarted pod and tailing logs; monitoring lag and commit behaviour.
mike: also scaling replicas from 2 -> 4 to absorb backlog: 
```
kubectl scale deployment metering-ingest-consumer --replicas=4 -n metering
```
luis: if counts are under-reported, we should put invoices on hold until reconciliation. @emily can you pause the invoice job? :warning:
emily: Ack — pausing invoice job and notifying finance ops.
finance-bot: Invoicing pipeline paused for billing-run-2026-03-14 by emily (reason: metering ingest lag)
sarah: lag dropping, now ~120k (from 1.2M). Consumers rejoined successfully after restart & scale.
raj: kicking off backfill job to reprocess unconsumed messages into token-aggregator. Using consumer-backfill with --from-offset <committed-offset>.
raj: backfill command: 
```
./consumer-backfill --topic metering-ingest --group backfill-worker --from-offset earliest --parallel 8
```
mike: temporary mitigation: bypassing prefix cache for aggregates to avoid stale sums until backfill completes.
luis: which customers are at risk? we need to prepare comms.
emily: finance has a list: 6 enterprise accounts with large expected usage. Preparing template notices and pausing auto-pay for these invoices until reconciliation.
sarah: plan for handoff: I'll watch another 20m then hand to raj. If lag spikes >5m we re-escalate to SEV team.
mike: created a short-lived metric alert to catch >200k inflight for >5m.
raj: backfill started, ETA ~45m depending on throughput. Monitoring job logs.
sarah: recorded mitigation steps and commands in thread for postmortem. Root cause looks like http-client patch introduced a regression causing intermittent timeouts during offset commits.
luis: action item — finance wants a confirmation before unpausing invoicing. emily will coordinate.
emily: will not unpause until backfill completes and counts verified. Sending customers a heads-up now.
pagerduty: Incident status updated: acknowledged -> monitoring (auto-escalate in 30m if conditions not met)
incident-bot: tagging follow-ups: create PM for revert of http-client patch, add circuit breaker to consumer commit path, and add more graceful commit retries.
sarah: last check: lag ~2k, token-delta projection after backfill ~0.1% (low risk to revenue).
raj: taking on-call handoff — I'm primary for the next 4 hours. Ping me if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
mike: leaving notes: kube commands, logs, backfill invocation in case we need to rerun.
incident-bot: Incident moved to monitoring. Will update when backfill finishes or if it auto-escalates.
emily: finance will hold affected invoices and send comms.
sarah: thanks all — good work. Will add postmortem draft and owners (raj, mike, luis) once we confirm backfill results.
raj: acknowledged, picking this up.
